nodes.label: Consume Governed Event-Calculated Ontology Projections
nodes.meaning: A governed Context obtains one challengeable ontology projection calculated from canonical subject events at an exact cut.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy product-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Capability admission does not admit this business ontology or prove realization.
nodes.challenge_route: CyberAlchemy product-ontology owner at G-D65-PRODUCT

nodes.label: Governed Context Consumer
nodes.meaning: One existing CyberAlchemy Context that requests a bounded ontology view for an intended use.
nodes.scope: Consumer identity; not a DDD bounded context, ontology source, or authority carrier.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy Context product owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Folder placement, labels, or projection ownership cannot create Context identity or authority.
nodes.challenge_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner

nodes.label: Context Product Owner
nodes.meaning: The owner who selects the Context's intended use, selector eligibility, and acceptable view boundary.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy Context product owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: This owner cannot decide runtime correctness or system-ontology admission alone.
nodes.challenge_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner

nodes.label: Integration Business-Ontology Owner
nodes.meaning: The owner of capability-local bridge meaning, contract identity, and business admission residue.
nodes.owner_route: ontology integration business-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Business-ontology ownership does not grant system, compiler, implementation, or cutover authority.
nodes.challenge_route: Ontology Lifecycle Project owner at G-D65-BUSINESS

nodes.label: Business-System Bridge
nodes.meaning: A typed, source-bound alignment contract between capability-local business meaning and future system-runtime meaning with identities kept distinct.
nodes.scope: Contract definition only; no system endpoint or realization instance is claimed at D65-S3.
nodes.owner_route: ontology integration business-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: A bridge contract is not a compiled graph, adapter, implementation binding, conformance verdict, or execution permission.
nodes.challenge_route: Business-ontology owner plus future system-ontology owner

nodes.label: Context Selector
nodes.meaning: An immutable Context-owned request naming one semantic cursor, subject set, governance join policy, intended use, and projection profile.
nodes.owner_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: A selector does not append events, admit subjects, choose authority, or become a projection.
nodes.challenge_route: Context product owner at G-D65-BUSINESS

nodes.label: Canonical Event Cut
nodes.meaning: A complete gap-free semantic event prefix through one graph-wide cursor plus every governance event required by the exact join policy.
nodes.scope: Business contract for consistent ontology state; runtime mechanics deferred.
nodes.owner_route: ontology integration business-ontology owner plus runtime owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: A cut is not a mutable snapshot, wall-clock time, migration decision, or authority verdict.
nodes.challenge_route: Runtime owner plus integration conformance owner

nodes.label: Event-Calculated Projection
nodes.meaning: A deterministic derivative view calculated only from one valid selector and canonical event cut, retaining exact provenance and forbidden authority moves.
nodes.scope: Business read-model contract; no projection bytes or implementation claimed.
nodes.owner_route: ontology integration business-ontology owner plus runtime owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: A projection, snapshot, index, or human view cannot be a replay source or admission decision.
nodes.challenge_route: Runtime owner plus integration conformance owner

nodes.label: Context Projection Binding
nodes.meaning: A version-exact relation permitting one registered selector to invoke one projection profile under one cut policy and governance join contract.
nodes.scope: Business binding; not a CAV2-D65 implementation ConstructionBinding.
nodes.owner_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: This binding contains no Rust symbol, access grant, Context activation, or cutover authority.
nodes.challenge_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner

nodes.label: Integration Epoch
nodes.meaning: One immutable identity for the complete selected semantic predecessor set and validation attempt for an integration candidate.
nodes.scope: Epoch contract; this D65-S3 package binds only the predecessors currently available.
nodes.owner_route: Ontology Lifecycle Project owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: An epoch is not an event cursor, release version, promotion, acceptance, or cutover permission.
nodes.challenge_route: Ontology Lifecycle Project owner plus changed predecessor owners

nodes.label: Challenge Route
nodes.meaning: The concrete owner and gate path for a valid objection to one bridge subject, relation, transition, or evidence claim.
nodes.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus challenged subject owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: A challenge route is not a verdict, confidence score, appeal result, or automatic blocker beyond its declared subject.
nodes.challenge_route: Definitions-governance owner plus challenged subject owner

nodes.label: Exact Governance Join Policy
nodes.meaning: The rule selecting which governance events must resolve against the exact semantic event identities visible at a cut.
nodes.scope: Business contract for governance completeness and exactness.
nodes.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus governance-model owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: A join policy cannot invent, borrow, or promote governance state.
nodes.challenge_route: Governance-model owner plus business-ontology owner

nodes.label: Projection Profile
nodes.meaning: A registered declaration of fields, renderings, relation scope, allowed readings, and forbidden authority inferences for one view kind.
nodes.scope: View-shape meaning independent of adapter or serializer.
nodes.owner_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: A profile does not make generated bytes canonical or prove consumer suitability.
nodes.challenge_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner

nodes.label: Valid Context Projection Available
nodes.meaning: A registered Context receives the exact bounded ontology view requested by its valid binding.
nodes.scope: Desired business outcome, not runtime evidence.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy product owner plus Context product owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: A desired outcome is not evidence that a projection was delivered.
nodes.challenge_route: CyberAlchemy product owner

nodes.label: Exact Cut Traceable
nodes.meaning: Every delivered view can be traced to its selector, event cursor, event-set digest, subjects, relations, and exact governance joins.
nodes.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus conformance owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Traceability metadata alone is not replay equality or conformance proof.
nodes.challenge_route: Integration conformance owner

nodes.label: Invalid Cut Rejected
nodes.meaning: Missing, mixed, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable source or governance dependencies fail closed before a view is delivered.
nodes.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus conformance owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Rejection is not evidence that all other requests are valid.
nodes.challenge_route: Integration conformance owner

nodes.label: Canonical Event Truth
nodes.meaning: Only canonical per-node and per-relation semantic event histories calculate semantic ontology state.
nodes.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus runtime owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Mutable nodes, snapshots, indexes, contexts, graphs, and projections are never replay sources.
nodes.challenge_route: Business-ontology owner plus runtime owner

nodes.label: Context Is Consumer Only
nodes.meaning: A Context frames and consumes a view without owning alternate ontology truth or adding canonical subject state.
nodes.owner_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Different Context views do not imply forked ontology histories.
nodes.challenge_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner

nodes.label: One Exact Cut Required
nodes.meaning: Every projection request resolves one complete cut; mixing cursors or latest-subject snapshots is forbidden.
nodes.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus runtime owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Wall-clock proximity or database locality cannot substitute for exact cursor closure.
nodes.challenge_route: Runtime owner plus conformance owner

nodes.label: Deterministic Projection
nodes.meaning: The same exact selector and valid cut must calculate byte-identical projection meaning and identity.
nodes.scope: Business determinism obligation; later stages define byte realization.
nodes.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus compiler and runtime owners
nodes.forbidden_inference: Declaring determinism does not prove an implementation deterministic.
nodes.challenge_route: Compiler owner plus integration conformance owner

nodes.label: Bridge Endpoint Identity Separation
nodes.meaning: Business and future system endpoints retain independent identities, owners, evidence, and admission state.
nodes.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus future system-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Name equality, directory placement, or relation presence cannot prove realization or equivalence.
nodes.challenge_route: Business-ontology and system-ontology owners

nodes.label: Fulfill Context Projection Request
nodes.meaning: Validate one registered binding and selector, resolve one exact cut and governance join, calculate the projection, validate it, and deliver or reject it.
nodes.scope: Business workflow contract; no API or adapter selected.
nodes.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus Context product owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Workflow definition is not implementation or evidence of execution.
nodes.challenge_route: Business-ontology owner at G-D65-BUSINESS

nodes.label: Resolve Projection Challenge
nodes.meaning: Classify a valid challenge, route it to the responsible owner/gate, block dependent use, record resolution or residue, and append revisions rather than rewriting history.
nodes.owner_route: challenged subject owner plus business-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Routing a challenge does not decide its merits.
nodes.challenge_route: Definitions-governance owner plus challenged subject owner

nodes.label: Selector Admission Policy
nodes.meaning: Only versioned, owner-routed selectors with a current Context binding may request a projection.
nodes.owner_route: Context product owner plus business-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Selector eligibility is not ontology subject admission or access-control authorization.
nodes.challenge_route: Context product owner

nodes.label: Projection Delivery Policy
nodes.meaning: Deliver a projection only when selector, binding, cut, governance join, digest, and projection-profile checks all pass.
nodes.owner_route: business-ontology owner plus conformance owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: Delivery does not imply product outcome proof or admission of any source subject.
nodes.challenge_route: Integration conformance owner

nodes.label: Challenge Blocking Policy
nodes.meaning: A valid unresolved load-bearing challenge blocks only its declared dependent uses and successors until owner resolution or explicit residue treatment.
nodes.owner_route: challenged subject owner plus business-ontology owner
nodes.forbidden_inference: A challenge cannot become an unscoped global veto or an automatic verdict.
nodes.challenge_route: Challenged subject owner at its named resolution gate
